BaseUrl.description: Only a configured HTTP(S) origin may be used for Home Assistant links.

EntityId.description: The mutable entity_id is a display/link hint, never a reference identity.

ItemId.description: Stable public item identity; occurrence identities change after completion.

RegistryId.description: Registry identities are opaque and never normalized or inferred from names.

ReorderItem.description: The server freezes trusted item content; callers supply no purchase details.

ReorderReceipt.description: An immutable acknowledgement, retained independently of the source task.

SourceRef.description: Opaque source identity. Values are retained exactly, including case and spacing.

info.description: Local one-off, standing and recurring maintenance tasks, owner-managed standing instructions, source-preserving migrations, completion history and durable reorder requests. Recurring tasks require a due date; instructions cannot be completed. Bearer authentication. Creates, completions, reorders and checklist changes require Idempotency-Key; item mutations require the quoted If-Match revision.
info.title: Maintenance API

get.summary: Readiness only. Never returns household state or credentials.
Registry labels are ephemeral and visible only to administrators.

post.summary: Import only new definitions, atomically. Missing items never delete history.

put.summary: Publish only the minimal device/entity registry through the dedicated adapter.

get.summary: List items in due-date order, using a cursor scoped to the archive filter.

post.summary: Create a new maintenance definition and its first occurrence.

delete.description: Reorder receipts remain available; deleted item and source IDs stay reserved.
delete.summary: Permanently remove an archived item and its completion history.

patch.summary: Omitted fields stay unchanged; null clears only optional fields.

put.summary: Check one step of the current occurrence without advancing its schedule.

post.summary: Commit one completion and one next occurrence in the same transaction.

post.description: Exact retries return the original receipt, even after source or request changes.
post.summary: Persist a reorder request and immutable acknowledgement without purchasing anything.
Atomically preserve source definitions, status, identities and history.
Read-only, target-aware mapping and conflict report for a migration.

get.summary: List requests in stable creation order with a status-scoped cursor.
